newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil extends losses at close, outlook weak.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil extends losses at close, outlook weak.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURE PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Sentiment remained weak and the market ended the week down on technical selling and poor fundamentals. The market is still weak and new third month Aug futures will break 1,220 rgt, and then reach 1,200 if there are no supportive leads. Active July broke the 1,235 support. Trading was cautious
PALM OIL PHYSICAL- Scattered dealing with prroducts lacking buying interest. CPOs saw interest more in the southern region.
On Thursday, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority said April exports were at 570,067 tonnes against trade expectations of 600,000-610,000 tonnes.
There was a lack of follow-through buying in the physical market and dealers were seen selling in the sector.
"The market looks oversold and people were seen looking for a rebound," a trader said, adding that any brief rebound could see players taking profits.
"Technically, the charts are still showing a downward trend and prices are expected to fall due to poor fundamentals," the trader said.
Production is expected to rise gradually in coming months due to high harvest seasons and this could led to a build-up in stocks.

"August futures (new third month) was dealing between 1,222 and 1,235 ringgit," a trader said. "The tone is bearish and if Aug futures contract breaks the 1,220, then the next support will be 1,200 ringgit."
The August futures contract closed 12 ringgit to 1,222 ringgit ($491.35) a tonne.

Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,310 vs bids of 1,302.50 after trading from 1,310. May (central) saw offers at 1,287.50 vs bids 1,280. June (south) was offered at 1,305 vs bids at 1,295. June (central) saw offers at 1,282.50 versus bids at 1,270.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $550, June at $545, and July/Aug/Sept at $537.50.

May RBD palm olein saw offers at $587.50, June at $582.50, July at $570 and July/Aug/Sept at $565. May RBD palm stearin was offered at $417.50 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $275.-Tan Lee Lee- 603-230-7510 ($1 =2.4870 ringgit)
